scripts.apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(mise where java@temurin-21) ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Android/Sdk ./gradlew assembleDebug -q && mkdir -p ../releases && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../releases/edh-hub-$(node -p "require('../package.json').version")-debug.apk
scripts.apk:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(mise where java@temurin-21) ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Android/Sdk ./gradlew assembleRelease -q && mkdir -p ../releases && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../releases/edh-hub-$(node -p "require('../package.json').version").apk
